author: Student Name
description: A modern REST API and web-based management panel for managing scheduled tasks (Cronjobs) on Linux servers. Provides a secure API layer for crontab operations with a beautiful React dashboard.
features: Cron API - Read and modify crontab via REST endpoints
Dashboard - Visual interface showing job status, schedules, and errors
Period Wizard - Convert complex cron expressions to human-readable format
Force Run - Manual execution of jobs before scheduled time
Log Tracking - Record stdout/stderr output and execution history
Auto Control - Automatic status monitoring and error detection
Auto Test - Self-check mechanism for testing functionality
